en.hero_tagline: YOUR ONE-STOP DIY CRAFT WORKSHOPS, EVENTS & SUPPLIES
en.about_p1: Crafted By You was founded in 2022 with a simple purpose — to create meaningful, hands-on craft experiences for people and businesses.
en.about_p2: We specialise in DIY craft workshops and have extensive experience handling corporate events, team-building sessions, birthday parties, product launches, and promotional activities for brands and banks. Our workshops are designed to be engaging, creative, and suitable for all skill levels.
en.about_p3: At Crafted By You, we believe that creativity is more than an activity — it's a way to connect, unwind, and create moments that last beyond the workshop itself.
en.services_intro: At Crafted By You, we design and organise hands-on DIY craft experiences tailored for corporate events, team building, brand activations, and private gatherings. From mindful wellness workshops to creative group activities, our sessions are thoughtfully curated to engage, inspire, and bring people together. Whether it's a small team session or a large-scale event, we customise each experience to suit your objectives, audience, and occasion.
en.service_1_desc: Creative workshops designed to strengthen teamwork, communication, and engagement through hands-on crafting experiences.
en.service_2_desc: Interactive craft activities for product launches, appreciation events, exhibitions, and client engagement programs.
en.service_3_desc: Themed craft experiences aligned with major celebrations including Chinese New Year, Hari Raya, Deepavali, and more.
en.service_4_desc: Mindful crafting sessions that promote relaxation, creativity, and well-being.
en.service_5_desc: Custom DIY craft experiences for birthdays, weddings, family days, and special occasions.
en.service_6_desc: Workshops tailored to your event goals, audience, and brand theme.
en.services_gallery_note: Please refer to our Gallery for photos.
en.workshops_intro: Explore our curated selection of DIY craft experiences, thoughtfully designed to inspire creativity, relaxation, and connection. From hands-on favourites to seasonal and customised workshops, our offerings continue to evolve. If you're looking for a craft activity not listed here, feel free to reach out — we're happy to create something just for you.
en.mosaic_coaster_desc: Mosaic art has a rich history, dating back to ancient civilizations, and it continues to be a popular and versatile art form today.
en.acrylic_pour_desc: It is a form of abstract art that involves pouring various colors of acrylic paint onto a canvas to create unique, visually captivating designs; with a marbled or cellular appearance.
en.fluid_bear_desc: Let the fluid paint flow over a white bear figurine to create dynamic patterns. Then dress up your bear beautifully!
en.herbal_fragrance_desc: A blend of natural herbs and dried flowers that gently releases its aroma over time, promoting relaxation, freshness, and balance.
en.sand_candle_desc: Inspired by the intricate beauty of traditional sand paintings, this candle not only captivates with its vibrant design but also fills your space with your preferred fragrances.
en.bath_salt_desc: Create your own aroma diffuser with Himalayan and Epsom salts. You can use it as an aroma diffuser, scrubbing bath salt, or foot soak.
en.scented_candle_desc: Handcraft a scented candle infused with fragrance oils to produce a pleasant aroma when burned. These candles can create a cozy and inviting atmosphere while offering potential aromatherapy benefits.
en.tufting_desc: Discover the joy of the latest trending pastime: crafting your own rug. We provide the tools and expert guidance to help you use a tufting gun and create a unique rug. Join us on this delightful rug-making journey!
en.neon_sign_desc: Experience Korean-style neon sign crafting and learn how to light it up. You can create your own neon signs inspired by vibrant and expressive neon signage. Materials used include flexible LED neon lights, canvas or acrylic boards, and various tools.
en.terrarium_desc: A terrarium is a miniature ecosystem contained in a transparent container. You can create a self-sustaining environment for plants, often with decorative elements like stones, moss, or small figurines. Terrariums are a popular way to bring a piece of nature indoors and can be both aesthetically pleasing and low-maintenance.
en.body_lotion_desc: Ever wonder how body lotion is made? Learn to DIY your own naturally derived body lotion that is refreshing and definitely non-greasy.
en.mosaic_vase_desc: Mosaic art has a rich history, dating back to ancient civilizations, and it continues to be a popular and versatile art form today. Let's craft a night light vase now.
en.cute_charm_desc: Create your own personalised charm using colourful alphabet letters, a plush charm, and a fluffy heart pom-pom. Design a unique keychain to decorate your bag or keys - fun, creative, and perfect for all ages.
en.spa_scrub_desc: Create your own natural body scrub using natural ingredients. Blend your preferred floral scent and take home a beautifully crafted scrub for gentle exfoliation and a relaxing spa-like experience.
en.wellness_mist_desc: Enter our exclusive Mist Lab and craft a personalised spray infused with premium essential oils. Curate your own mood blend — from Focus to Confidence — and take home a scent designed to elevate your day.
en.aroma_diffuser_desc: Crafted from high-purity gypsum/ceramic and hand-polished for a clean, elegant look that suits any space. It requires no water and no heat, helping to preserve the natural properties of essential oils while gently diffusing their aroma.
en.images_disclaimer: * Images are for illustrative purposes only
en.gallery_intro: A glimpse into our creative moments — from intimate workshops to large-scale events. Each photo captures the joy of making, the beauty of hands-on experiences, and the meaningful connections formed through creativity.
en.partner_intro: At Crafted By You, we collaborate wiht experienced workshops facilitators to offer a wider range of creative and experiential activities. Through these partnership, we are able to bring unique workshops and specialised skills to our community, ensuring every experience remain engaging, meaningful, and thoughtfully curated.
en.partner_brand_copy: MYENSY Academy The online system provides DIY HAnds-on courses, professional aromatherapy certification, customized perfumery guide, and a points small offering pure essential oils, carrier oil, and material kits. This allow you to easily complete the entire "learn + do + create" experience from the comfort of you home
en.clients_intro: We're grateful to have worked with a diverse range of clients, from corporate organisations and brands to developers and private groups. Each collaboration reflects a shared belief in creating meaningful, engaging experiences through creativity, and we value the trust our clients place in us to bring their ideas to life.
en.footer_copyright: © Crafted By You — Done In Style

zh.hero_tagline: 您一站式DIY工艺工作坊、活动和用品中心
zh.about_p1: Crafted By You 成立于 2022 年，目的很简单——为人们和企业创造有意义的手工工艺体验。
zh.about_p2: 我们专门从事DIY工艺工作坊，在处理企业活动、团队建设会议、生日派对、产品发布会和品牌及银行推广活动方面拥有丰富经验。我们的工作坊设计新颖、创意十足，适合所有技能水平的人员。
zh.about_p3: 在 Crafted By You，我们相信创意不仅仅是一项活动——它是连接、放松和创造超越工作坊本身的时刻的方式。
zh.services_title: 🌿 Crafted By You —— 我们的服务
zh.services_intro: 在 Crafted By You，我们设计和组织量身定制的手工DIY工艺体验，适用于企业活动、团队建设、品牌激活和私人聚会。从正念健康工作坊到创意小组活动，我们的课程经过精心策划，以吸引、启发和团结人们。无论是小型团队会议还是大规模活动，我们都会根据您的目标、受众和场合定制每种体验。
zh.service_1_desc: 通过动手工艺体验，设计创意工作坊以加强团队合作、沟通和参与度。
zh.service_2_desc: 为产品发布、感谢活动、展览和客户参与计划提供互动工艺活动。
zh.service_3_desc: 与春节、开斋节、排灯节等主要庆祝活动相协调的主题工艺体验。
zh.service_4_title: 健康和生活方式工作坊
zh.service_4_desc: 促进放松、创意和幸福感的正念工艺课程。
zh.service_5_desc: 为生日、婚礼、家庭日和特殊场合定制DIY工艺体验。
zh.service_6_desc: 根据您的活动目标、受众和品牌主题定制工作坊。
zh.services_gallery_note: 请参考我们的相册了解更多照片。
zh.workshops_intro: 探索我们精心策划的DIY工艺体验，旨在激发创意、放松和连接。从动手最爱到季节性和定制工作坊，我们的产品库不断发展。如果您正在寻找这里未列出的工艺活动，请随时与我们联系——我们很乐意为您创建一些特别的东西。
zh.mosaic_coaster_desc: 马赛克艺术有着悠久的历史，可追溯到古代文明，时至今日仍是一种流行且多功能的艺术形式。
zh.acrylic_pour_desc: 这是一种抽象艺术形式，涉及将各种颜色的丙烯酸涂料倒在画布上以创建独特的、视觉上引人注目的设计；具有大理石纹或细胞外观。
zh.fluid_bear_desc: 让流体油漆流过白色熊胚，创造动态图案。你把熊打扮得很漂亮！
zh.herbal_fragrance_desc: 天然草本和干花的混合物，缓缓释放其香气。以促进放松、新鲜感和平衡。
zh.sand_candle_desc: 受传统沙画的复杂美感启发，这支蜡烛不仅以其充满活力的设计吸引人，而且还能用您喜欢的香氛填充您的空间。
zh.bath_salt_desc: 用喜马拉雅盐和泻盐制作您自己的香氛扩散器。您可以将其用作香氛扩散器、去角质浴盐和足浴。
zh.scented_candle_desc: 手工制作注入香精油的香薰蜡烛，在燃烧时散发宜人的香气。这些蜡烛可以营造温暖舒适的氛围，也具有潜在的芳香疗法益处。
zh.tufting_desc: 享受参与最新趋势爱好的乐趣：制作您自己的地毯。我们提供工具和专家指导，帮助您使用簇绒枪创建独特的地毯。加入我们，一起踏上制地毯的愉快之旅！
zh.neon_sign_desc: 体验韩国霓虹灯牌的知识和照亮它的方式！您可以制作自己的霓虹灯牌，灵感来自充满活力和表达力的霓虹灯招牌。所用材料为柔性LED霓虹灯、画布/亚克力板和各种工具。
zh.terrarium_desc: 生态瓶是一个包含在透明容器中的微型生态系统。您可以为植物创建自我维持的环境，通常带有装饰元素，如石头、苔藓或小雕像。生态瓶是将自然带入室内的流行方式，既美观又易于维护。
zh.body_lotion_desc: 想知道身体乳液是如何制作的吗？学习制作您自己的天然成分身体乳液，清爽且绝对不油腻。
zh.mosaic_vase_desc: 马赛克艺术有着悠久的历史，可追溯到古代文明，时至今日仍是一种流行且多功能的艺术形式。现在让我们制作一个夜灯花瓶。
zh.cute_charm_desc: 使用彩色字母、毛绒挂饰和蓬松爱心绒球，创作独一无二的个性挂饰。设计专属钥匙扣来装饰您的包或钥匙——有趣、有创意，适合所有年龄。
zh.spa_scrub_desc: 使用天然原料制作您自己的天然磨砂膏。混合您喜欢的花香，带回家一款精心制作的磨砂膏，用于温和去角质和放松的SPA般体验。
zh.wellness_mist_desc: 进入我们独家的薄雾实验室，制作一款融入优质精油的个性化喷雾。调配您自己的情绪香调——从专注到自信——带回家一款专为提升您一天而设计的香氛。
zh.aroma_diffuser_desc: 由高纯度石膏/陶瓷制成，手工抛光，外观简洁优雅，适合任何空间。无需水，无需加热，有助于保留精油的天然特性，同时轻柔扩散其香气。
zh.gallery_intro: 一瞥我们的创意时刻——从亲密工作坊到大型活动。每张照片都捕捉了制作的喜悦、动手体验的美妙以及通过创意形成的有意义的连接。
zh.partner_intro: 在 Crafted By You，我们与经验丰富的工作坊导师合作，提供更广泛的创意与体验式活动。通过这些合作关系，我们能够为社群带来独特的工作坊与专业技能，确保每一次体验都保持有趣、有意义，并经过细致策划。
zh.partner_brand_copy: MYENSY Academy 在线系统提供 DIY 实作课程、专业芳疗认证、定制香水指导，以及售卖纯精油、基础油和材料包的小商店，让您在家中也能轻松完成完整的“学习 + 动手 + 创作”体验。
zh.clients_intro: 我们很感谢与各种各样的客户合作，从企业组织和品牌到开发商和私人团体。每次合作都反映了对通过创意创造有意义、吸引人的体验的共同信念，我们感谢客户对我们将他们想法化为现实的信任。
